en-US.name: Home Hub
en-US.description: Custom skill for the Home Hub apartment automation system. Sets activity modes (gaming, working, relax, etc.), controls Sonos playback, and runs scenes via voice. Single-user, unpublished — runs only on Anthony's developer-account Echo devices.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell command center to set relax mode
Alexa, ask command center to pause the music

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Single-user developer skill. No certification needed — invoked on Anthony's developer-account-linked Echo only.
